## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): execute frozen ≥2,000 datasets per
  scenario battery + retained independent derivation/routing review
  with actual method/draw metadata; record generators/seeds/errors,
  availability/width/verdict/MC uncertainty and diagnostic prior
  sensitivity through the native report path.
- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): unknown tolerance, unrun/failed scenario,
  mismatch, unavailable endpoint or resource breach cannot count as
  method admission; partial results retained; no favorable-method
  fallback; numerical scope ≤8h/4 cores/8GiB/32 core-hours/2GiB only.

  H-010 predicates + aliases → numbered checks + actual evidence in
  the coverage register; achieved D/E separate from owed R/P +

- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal gate): green in scope; REQ ids stamped;
  DEFERRALS rows for owed (DF-R5.17-1 resolved here per contract);
  ADRs for owned decisions; run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree;
  operating clauses; ≤2KiB phase log; no deferred predicate MET.

1. `crates/hh-eval/src/finite_manifest.rs` — DF-R5.17-1 repair:
   parameterize the conjugate update by `decl.prior` (posterior mean
   `(c+a)/(n+a+b)` per arm; draws `beta_inv_ppm(u, c+a, n−c+b)`);
   factor the shared cell-resolution/draw core so the sim headline

2. `crates/hh-eval/src/sim_battery.rs` (new) — the frozen protocol:
   `SCENARIOS` table covering S.4 (T{10,20,30}×R{5,10}×effect
   {0,±.05,±.10} easy grid; hard-mixture leg; heterogeneous-effects
   leg; zero-activation / informative-missingness-veto / shared-shock
   mechanism legs; beta{2,2} diagnostic prior-sensitivity arms),
   ≥2,000 datasets declared per cell, seed rule
   `H(canonical(scenario_id ∥ battery_version ∥ replicate_index))`

   → `finite_manifest` headline; per-scenario availability, refusal
   census, diagnostic coverage (labelled diagnostic — never nominal),
   width, observed-vs-true error, sign-flip verdict/type-I leg,
   binomial MC error; closed `BatteryError`; `run` takes a wall/

   admission; `to_json` integer-canonical record.
3. `crates/hh-eval/examples/r5_40_battery.rs` — the execution driver

   core-hours / ≤2GiB cited, never pooled).
4. `crates/hh-analysis/tests/r5_40.rs` — routed battery: protocol
   completeness, seed/dataset determinism, headline==estimator
   bit-identity, small-N probes per leg, designed refusals,
   resource-breach → stopped-not-admitted, prior-sensitivity
   (beta{2,2} EX-02 mean 111_111 + independent SplitMix64/order-
   statistic sampler endpoints + registered arm byte-identical),
   routed `analyze`/`analyze_and_record` beta{2,2} persisted-report
   legs (native report path), admission-rollup never counts unrun/

5. Build-memory: ADR-0418 (prior repair + frozen battery protocol —
